predecessors.name: Principality of Polotsk
predecessors.text: Koknese, 'a small vassal state of the Principality of Polotsk'

successors.name: Livonian Brothers of the Sword
successors.text: Koknese, 'taken over by the Brothers of the Sword' by 1209

ledger.x: About 1180: the Principality of Koknese is established as a vassal of Polotsk.
1209: the Brothers of the Sword take Koknese.

The Principality of Koknese ends in the Brothers of the Sword's hands; they held it until it 'was transferred to the Bishopric of Riga in 1238' and Polotsk's sovereignty 'was finally revoked in 1215'.

wars.name: Livonian conquest of Koknese
wars.outcome: Vetseke gave half of his land to Albert of Riga in 1205 for protection; by 1209 the Brothers of the Sword had taken Koknese; the page tells of Vetseke's rebellion, his burnt castle and his flight to Novgorod without years.

certainty.note: A castle lordship on the Daugava; the pages name the castle and Polotsk's sovereignty, never a frontier line.
